move: icons drop from above, bounce and squash on impact, wiggle, spring out
how: A 4x2 grid of 140px rounded app icons (each with a white line icon and a blurred ellipse shadow beneath) on a light stage. CustomBounce.create('drop', {strength:0.55, squash:3}) builds a bounce ease and its paired 'drop-squash' ease. Each icon, staggered 0.13 from 2%, drops from y:-520 over 1.1s with the 'drop' bounce ease while scaleX 1.25 / scaleY 0.75 is applied with the 'drop-squash' ease so it flattens on each impact (transform-origin bottom); its shadow grows from scaleX 0.2/opacity 0 with the same bounce. At 54% all icons wiggle rotation 6 yoyo (sine.inOut, stagger 0.05). Exit at 79%: icons anticipate with y:-40, scaleY 1.1/scaleX 0.9 (power2.out) then launch to y:-600 with power3.in staggered 0.05 while shadows shrink and fade.
adapt: Change icon count, colours and the inline SVG glyphs; tune strength/squash in CustomBounce.create; keep the 1.1s drop with 0.13 stagger and the anticipate-then-launch exit.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the grid of .cell/.shadow/.app from shot.icons; animate(el, shot, D) registers the CustomBounce eases once (names are global), returns the same timeline with drops at 0.02-0.5 of D, wiggle at 0.54, exit at 0.79. Requires CustomEase and CustomBounce; toArray('.app') must be scoped to el.
caveats: CustomBounce ease names ('drop', 'drop-squash') are global registrations
